name: AI4Impact — Course Enrolled
trigger: Enrollment becomes registered, including staff/manual or free registration. Paid enrollments use the payment-confirmation email.
subject: Course enrollment confirmed
body: Your enrollment in {course_title} is confirmed. Open My learning to get started.

name: AI4Impact — Course Completed
trigger: Enrollment status changes to completed.
subject: Course completed
body: Your course {course_title} is marked complete. Open your course workspace to review your progress and certificate eligibility.

name: AI4Impact — Course Access Updated
trigger: Manual enrollment status changes to dropped.
subject: Course access updated
body: Your enrollment in {course_title} is no longer active. Contact support if this was unexpected.

name: AI4Impact — Payment Confirmed
trigger: Verified Razorpay captured payment changes order to paid. Test transactions are labeled TEST.
subject: Payment confirmed

name: AI4Impact — Refund Partial
trigger: Verified cumulative refunded amount increases without reaching the full payment.
subject: Partial refund confirmed

name: AI4Impact — Refund Full
trigger: Verified cumulative refund reaches the full payment.
subject: Refund confirmed

name: AI4Impact — Certificate Issued
trigger: A new attendance, completion or internship certificate record is issued.
subject: Your certificate is ready
body: A {certificate_type} certificate has been issued. Sign in to the student portal and open your certificates to view it.

name: AI4Impact — Session Confirmed
trigger: Student confirms a group clarification or personal handholding booking.
subject: {session_title} - confirmed
body: Session starts {ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Open your bookings for details.

name: AI4Impact — Session Rescheduled
trigger: Staff changes a booked session or student reschedules to another slot.
subject: {session_title} - rescheduled
body: Session starts {new_ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Open your bookings for details.

name: AI4Impact — Session Cancelled
trigger: A booked session is cancelled; previous reminders expire.
subject: {session_title} - cancelled
body: Session starts {original_ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Open your bookings for details.

name: AI4Impact — Session Reminder
trigger: 24 hours and 1 hour before a confirmed future session, when still eligible.
subject: Upcoming session: {session_title}
body: Session starts {ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Open your bookings for details.

name: AI4Impact — Session Outcome
trigger: Staff records a completed session or no-show.
subject: {session_title} - {completed_or_no_show}
body: Session starts {ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Open your bookings for details.

name: AI4Impact — Webinar Confirmed
trigger: A visitor registers for a published webinar.
subject: {webinar_title} - confirmed
body: {webinar_title} starts {ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Join: {meeting_url}

name: AI4Impact — Webinar Updated
trigger: Registered webinar details change and campaign version advances.
subject: {webinar_title} - updated
body: {webinar_title} starts {new_ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Join: {meeting_url}

name: AI4Impact — Webinar Cancelled
trigger: A registered webinar is cancelled; previous reminders expire.
subject: {webinar_title} - cancelled
body: {webinar_title} starts {original_ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}).

name: AI4Impact — Webinar Reminder
trigger: 24 hours and 1 hour before a registered future webinar.
subject: Webinar reminder: {webinar_title}
body: {webinar_title} starts {ISO_datetime_with_offset} ({IANA_timezone}). Join: {meeting_url}

name: AI4Impact — Application Received
trigger: Student submits a recruitment job application.
subject: Application received
body: Your application for {job_title} was received.

name: AI4Impact — Application Updated
trigger: Staff changes recruitment application status.
subject: Application update
body: Your application status is now {status}.

name: AI4Impact — Internship Updated
trigger: Staff changes internship application status.
subject: Internship update
body: Your internship application status is now {status}.

name: AI4Impact — Course Announcement
trigger: Staff publishes a course announcement to enrolled students.
subject: {staff_subject}
body: {staff_message}

name: AI4Impact — Course Quote
trigger: Staff explicitly sends a personal course quote with its pro forma PDF.
subject: AI4Impact | Your course quote and demo checkout link
body:
Hello {student_name},

Your quote for {course_title} is INR {total}.
Marked price: INR {marked_price}
Discount: {discount_percentage}%

Demo checkout: {checkout_url}

This is a demonstration. No money is collected and completing it does not grant course access. The attached PDF is pro forma, not a tax invoice.

The AI4Impact team

name: AI4Impact — Fee Reminder
trigger: Staff explicitly sends an outstanding-fee reminder after preview. Limited to one per fee account per day.
subject: Fee reminder: {course_title}
body:
Hello {student_name},
Your outstanding fee for {course_title} is INR {outstanding}.
Next due: {due_on} (INR {next_amount}).
Pay securely: {existing_checkout_link_if_available}
Sign in to AI4Impact or reply to support@ai4impact.in if you need assistance.

name: AI4Impact — Fee Statement
trigger: Staff previews and emails an immutable statement for the selected date range.
subject: Your fee statement: {course_title}
body:
Hello {student_name},
Your outstanding fee for {course_title} is INR {outstanding}.
Next due: {due_on} (INR {next_amount}).
Sign in to AI4Impact or reply to support@ai4impact.in if you need assistance.

name: AI4Impact — Offline Payment Confirmed
trigger: Staff records cash/bank/offline UPI received, or clears a pending cheque.
subject: Offline payment received
body: A payment record for {course_title} is paid. Open your fee statement for the amount, reference and updated balance.

name: AI4Impact — Cheque Pending
trigger: Staff records a cheque; collection and course-access totals do not change until cleared.
subject: Cheque received - awaiting clearance
body: A payment record for {course_title} is pending. Open your fee statement for the amount, reference and updated balance.

name: AI4Impact — Offline Payment Reversed
trigger: Staff reverses or voids an offline receipt with a reason; history is retained.
subject: Offline payment reversed
body: A payment record for {course_title} is reversed. Open your fee statement for the amount, reference and updated balance.
